_README: Coordinates and exposure sectors are FIRST-PASS values derived from the itinerary text and general knowledge of the Aeolians. Every entry with "verified": false must be checked against satellite imagery and a pilot book before the fleet relies on it. An exposure sector is the arc of compass bearings (degrees true, [from, to] clockwise) that wind and swell arrive from when that berth becomes uncomfortable or untenable. A wrong sector produces a confidently wrong shelter recommendation.

portorosa.name: Portorosa Marina
portorosa.shelter_note: Fully enclosed artificial marina basin - all-round shelter.
portorosa.position_source: OSM 'Marina di Portorosa'; moved 325 m on 315°
portorosa.verification_note: On the north Sicily coast, outside the Isole Eolie chapter. Two independent web sources put the marina itself at 38.1222-38.1229 N, 15.1114-15.1122 E, about 550 m SE of this waypoint; both test as land against the OSM coastline because the basin is artificial. This position is therefore a deliberate offshore proxy in the approach water off the entrance, not a berth.
portorosa.hazard_note: Entering is difficult with wind and sea from the northwest. Approaching from the west (Capo Tindari), stay offshore - close in, the entrance lights appear in the wrong order.
portorosa.sector_source: marina listings agree with the enclosed-basin reading: breakwater and jetty give shelter from all winds

lipari_pignataro.name: Porto Pignataro
lipari_pignataro.shelter_note: Good shelter in summer. Open SW for a short distance; strong southerlies make it untenable. The pilot calls it the safest place on Lipari.
lipari_pignataro.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
lipari_pignataro.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
lipari_pignataro.hazard_note: Gusts out of the bay from W-NW. Entrance between moored boats and the breakwater is tight when a tripper boat is moving.

lipari_marina_lunga.name: Marina Lunga / Porto Lipari
lipari_marina_lunga.shelter_note: Open NE-SE. With gales from anywhere many berths may become untenable, particularly with southerlies.
lipari_marina_lunga.position_source: OSM 'Lipari Marina Lunga'; moved 125 m on 025°
lipari_marina_lunga.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
lipari_marina_lunga.hazard_note: Ground swell often creeps round beyond the harbour, and there is constant ferry wash. Keep pulled well off the pontoon.

lipari_valle_muria.name: Valle Muria
lipari_valle_muria.shelter_note: Open W and south. Anchor towards the N end in 5-10 m.
lipari_valle_muria.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
lipari_valle_muria.hazard_note: Reef at the S end of the bay.

panarea_sanpietro.name: San Pietro buoy field
panarea_sanpietro.shelter_note: Adequate in settled weather, but with any fresh wind or moderate sea from anywhere in the E this is not the place to be.
panarea_sanpietro.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
panarea_sanpietro.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
panarea_sanpietro.hazard_note: Cannot anchor within 200 m of the pier; keep clear of the laid moorings. Yachts generally not permitted on the pier.

panarea_drautto.name: Drautto buoy field
panarea_drautto.shelter_note: Nautilus buoy field in Baia di Drautto, the southeast-facing bay south of San Pietro. Open E through SW; sheltered from the NW sectors.
panarea_drautto.position_source: Campo Boe Nautilus, Baia di Drautto 38°37.73'N 015°04.20'E (operator listing); 70 m SE of OSM 'Spiaggetta di Drautto'
panarea_drautto.sector_source: derived from OSM coastline, rays to 5 nm
panarea_drautto.verification_note: Not described separately in the Isole Eolie chapter. Position corrected from 38.6315,15.0775, which lay ~720 m ENE - round Punta Torrione on the east-facing coast, not in the bay at all - and the sector re-derived from the corrected position. Two caveats on that sector: 200 m further offshore the open arc widens to 76-243, so the outer buoys are less sheltered than this figure; and a second source describes the bay as open to the NE, which the ray-cast attributes to Punta Torrione. Still a web cross-check, not a chart check.

panarea_zimmari.name: Cala Zimmari
panarea_zimmari.shelter_note: Open E and south. Anchor in 5-10 m on sand, good holding.
panarea_zimmari.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
panarea_zimmari.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
panarea_zimmari.hazard_note: The Punta Milazzese area is technically off limits - navigating and anchoring in the vicinity is prohibited, and you may be told to move on.

panarea_milazzese.name: Baia Milazzese
panarea_milazzese.shelter_note: South-facing bay under the Bronze Age headland. Best shelter on Panarea in a northerly.
panarea_milazzese.sector_source: derived from OSM coastline, rays to 5 nm
panarea_milazzese.verification_note: The pilot treats Baia Milazzese and Cala Zimmari together and gives one waypoint; this entry keeps its derived sector. A web cross-check agrees they are one piece of water - an Italian nautical guide puts Baia Milazzese at 38°37.62'N 015°04.12'E, 175 m from here, and lists Cala Junco separately 700 m SW. The 40 m gap between this entry and Cala Zimmari is real, not a coordinate slip.

stromboli_gabbiano.name: Marina del Gabbiano
stromboli_gabbiano.shelter_note: An open roadstead. With winds from almost any direction an uncomfortable swell rolls around here. Suitable in calm weather only - leave at the slightest sign of bad weather.
stromboli_gabbiano.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
stromboli_gabbiano.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
stromboli_gabbiano.hazard_note: Holding uncertain in places; underwater cables off the village. Mooring buoys N of the mole Apr-Oct; pick-up lines can be fouled.

filicudi_porto.name: Filicudi Porto
filicudi_porto.shelter_note: A short mole on the E side of the island; yachts anchor off in settled weather. About 20 visitors' moorings laid in the bay.
filicudi_porto.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
filicudi_porto.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
filicudi_porto.hazard_note: An old groyne runs about 100 m SE from the ferry mole, just under the surface and hard to see. Bottom stoney with weed; holding not good everywhere.

filicudi_pecorini.name: Pecorini a Mare
filicudi_pecorini.shelter_note: Anchor off rather than use the mole - there is really no room for yachts. Twelve yellow mooring buoys laid in summer.
filicudi_pecorini.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
filicudi_pecorini.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
filicudi_pecorini.hazard_note: There is nearly always some ground swell here, and it is deep everywhere. Not the calm alternative it looks on a chart.

salina_santamarina.name: Porto Santa Marina Salina
salina_santamarina.shelter_note: Good shelter in settled conditions in both harbours; the S basin affords the better all-round shelter. Strong southerlies would probably affect the S basin.
salina_santamarina.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
salina_santamarina.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383

salina_rinella.name: Rinella
salina_rinella.shelter_note: A short mole off a hamlet on the S coast. Open E-S.
salina_rinella.position_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
salina_rinella.sector_source: Imray Italian Waters Pilot (Heikell), Isole Eolie pp.371-383
salina_rinella.hazard_note: Limited anchoring room inside the laid local moorings; space outside them in 15 m+.

stromboli_sciara.name: Sciara del Fuoco
stromboli_sciara.note: Night viewing position on the NW side - the fleet sails here after dark to watch lava reach the sea. Stand off about 300 m from the foot of the scar.
stromboli_sciara.position_source: moved into the water off the Sciara; was 38.793,15.201, which is 619 m inland on the volcano's flank

salina_pollara.name: Pollara Bay
salina_pollara.note: Sunset and diving spot; Il Postino filming location.
salina_pollara.position_source: given by the fleet owner; 146 m off the coast in the bay. Earlier values were wrong twice: 38.572,14.816 was 1,137 m inland, and 38.577,14.800 was in the water but 540 m SW of the bay.

filicudi_la_canna.name: La Canna
filicudi_la_canna.note: 71 m volcanic pinnacle rising from the sea off the NW coast.
filicudi_la_canna.position_source: OSM/Wikidata Q3820695 'La Canna' islet; was 38.583,14.527, 500 m E of it

legs.label: Portorosa → Lipari
legs.note: First passage of the trip, out of the Golfo di Patti and north to the archipelago.

legs.label: Lipari → Stromboli (optional)
legs.note: Monday-night alternative to Panarea. Plan the return to Panarea for Tuesday.

legs.label: Panarea → Filicudi
legs.note: Longest passage of the trip - the full width of the archipelago, passing north of Salina.

legs.label: Filicudi → Salina
legs.note: Back east to Salina for the final group dinner.

legs.label: Salina → Portorosa
legs.note: Return passage. Hard arrival deadline of 16:00 - work backwards from it when picking a departure window.
